top_signals.title: Commission launches EU Screening Week with new recommendations on cardiovascular health checks
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 28 Sep 2026 Ahead of World Heart Day and to mark the launch of the first-ever EU Screening Week, the European Commission has adopted a proposal for a Council Recommendation on cardiovascular health checks. It aims to safeguard the health of European citizens by improving early detection and screening and, ultimately, reducing premature deaths from cardiovascular diseases.
